content.value: How to calculate the element address in two dimensional array? Consider the linear array (14) AA[30:80] and BB[-20:80].
i) Find the number of elements in each array.
ii) Suppose Base(AA) = 500 and $w = 8$ words per memory cell for $\bar { \mathsf { A A } } .$ Find the address AA[65] and AA[69].
